_doc: The asset seam: the ONLY place a visual ID maps to a file. Each entry is {"path": real art, "placeholder": stand-in}, plus any fields the consumer needs. See PLAN.md 5.3.

vis.tiles.material_atlas._doc: A column per tile type (in `cells` order), a row per variant, each cell padded by 1/18 of its stride. R = detail, G = untinted trim (PLAN.md 6.2), B = cut out (parts only). The thruster column holds one nozzle per type, a row each in `thruster_rows` order (A.2); a nozzle is thruster_body tinted thruster_tint_share of the way to its type's tint (the hangar's swatches use the full tint), and its trim band shows its level, L1-3 bronze, silver, gold. Built by tools/slice_sheets.py from art_src/sheets.json (A.1, A.2).

vis.tiles.damage._doc: Four damage overlays in a row, one per wear step, padded like the material atlas; R is multiplied over the tile (white = untouched). Built by tools/slice_sheets.py (A.1).

vis.fx.thrusters._doc: Thruster exhaust (PLAN.md 3.6), drawn in code with particles; no files. level_scale multiplies the size per level (L1-3). Colours run hot core -> fading edge.

vis.icon.hull._doc: Icons (A.4), one 128 px PNG each, cut from art_src/icons/icons_main_2.jpeg by tools/slice_sheets.py: the resources and GC, the HUD symbols (fire, switch, pause, boost) and the x2-x5 power-up badges (8.3, whose number the game writes in the empty centre). Every vis.icon.* shares one grey-ring placeholder; code that draws a symbol in text or shapes uses it only when Assets.has_real_art().

vis.weapons.atlas._doc: The guns (A.3, A.3c): a row of cells per mount type (`mounts`: a turret's round base, a fixed gun's flat bracket, a swivel's bracket with a pivot), a column per gun in vis.weapons `atlas_cells` order, then a trim-mask row per art row. Each cell is padded by pad_px, with the mount's pivot at pivot_px (a turret's housing centre, an edge gun's bracket where it meets the hull) and the barrel tip at tip_x_px. `empty` cells (mount:art) fall back to the turret row. Built by tools/slice_sheets.py from art_src/sheets.json; the geometry must match its GUN_* and EDGE_PIVOT constants. No placeholder file: without it GunView draws the guns in code.

vis.weapons._doc: Guns (PLAN.md 4.4). With vis.weapons.atlas, a gun is the head in its `atlas_cells` cell (`art` in `guns`, else the weapon id), and its trim band is `trim` (per weapon, else the default): HE red, AP amber. Without the atlas they're drawn in code: a turret is a round base with barrels, an edge gun a mounting block with them. Sizes in U. Each shot shows a muzzle flash flash_u across for flash_s. `guns` overrides barrels, barrel_width_u and flash_u per weapon. The hangar marks each gun's mode with a dot: manual or auto.

vis.fx.projectiles._doc: Shots in flight (Phase 4.3), drawn as additive tracer streaks in one MultiMesh; no files. Per weapon id, else default. length_u and width_u are the streak's size.

vis.fx.impacts._doc: Where a shot strikes (Phase 4.5), drawn in code with one MultiMesh of soft dots; no files. A hit flashes flash_u across and throws `sparks` back the way the shot came, at up to speed_u U/s, shrinking out over life_s. Per weapon id, else default.

vis.fx.explosion._doc: A ship's death (PLAN.md 4.2), drawn in code; no files. A white flash, an expanding ring and a burst of sparks (fireballs), sized by the ship: spark_size is [min, max] as a share of the ship's length. Colours run hot -> cooling.
